description: Java and Spring Boot services built with Maven or Gradle. Supplies build and test command defaults; other gates must be declared by the project.
architecture: Controller, service, and repository or mapper layers stay separated; business logic belongs in the service layer.
REST endpoints expose DTOs rather than persistence entities.
Transaction boundaries are declared at the service layer.
Spring Security configuration is security-sensitive and requires explicit review.
SQL and schema changes are reviewed for indexes, constraints, and migration safety.
Unit tests and integration tests are distinct; integration tests may require external services.
limitations: A manifest is evidence of build layout only. It does not prove that Spring Boot, a specific JDK, or any plugin is present and working.
No integration_test default is supplied, because neither Maven failsafe nor a Gradle integrationTest task is guaranteed to be configured.
No lint, typecheck, or security default is supplied, because Java projects share no single standard command for them.
Resolution never runs a wrapper, parses a build script, or verifies that a task exists.
This profile has not been validated against the legacy Java projects preserved in this repository.
